records.title: Coherent states of alternating current
records.authors: D. A. Ivanov, H. W. Lee, L. S. Levitov
records.read: Parsed Appendix C, Eqs. C1-C4, minimizing charge variance at fixed mean charge; Appendix D observation-window context. Requested page16 screenshot failed.
records.boundary: A genuine existing optimal-pulse problem, but not fixed-energy upstream many-body target preparation. Do not claim a first pulse optimization.

records.title: Dynamical Resurrection of the Visibility in a Mach-Zehnder Interferometer
records.read: Parsed main Eqs.2-7, overlap maximization, capacitive one-edge model, downstream application of correcting voltage, and surrounding text. ArXiv/publisher metadata checked. Screenshot page1 failed.
records.boundary: Already optimizes many-body overlap and restores the wavepacket. Additional downstream control and its one-edge phase transfer differ from the restricted upstream two-mode inverse. No contradiction or absence of prior overlap methods.

records.title: Fractionalization of minimal excitations in integer quantum Hall edge channels
records.read: Parsed Section III.A.2 and Eq.20 coherent displacement, correction statement and actual reference67 (L11), short-range two-channel Eqs.21-22, long-range/temperature limitations. Requested page6 screenshot failed.
records.boundary: The quantum transfer, pure output for voltage states and special clean fractionalization are inherited. The correction remark must not be treated as the same upstream energy-constrained theorem.

records.read: Full publisher PDF retrieved.
